component.name: DoCatz
component.summary: Docker containers with a domain each, herded by one cat

description.p: DoCatz is a desktop app for your Docker engine: containers grouped by compose project, each web container on its own name like https://web.shop.docatz.localhost, with logs, a terminal and files a click away.

ul.li: Compose projects with Up, Build, Restart and Down, and every container's logs, terminal, files and stats
A domain for each container over HTTPS, with a trusted local certificate
Images, volumes, networks and builds, with disk usage and clean-up
On Linux it runs the system's Docker Engine and installs it for you when it is missing
Works with DevCatz, DBCatz and DialCatz, and an AI helper that explains what it sees

description.p: Nothing changes outside its own folders until you choose it in the app.

screenshot.caption: A compose project with its containers and domains
Every container's logs as they come
A domain for every container, over HTTPS
